                            HOW TO PLAY

                            HIGHS & LOWS One daily round, explained with a real question.

                            SIX QUESTIONS A DAY1/4

                            Each one is about a real statistic.Find the highest or the lowest.

                            Pick a country on the globe and lock it in.One try per round.

                            CLOSE STILL COUNTS3/4

                              Spot on is 1,000 points.The nearer your country's figure, the more you score.

                              CLIMB THE WORLD4/4
                              TOP 12%

                              See your rank against the world every day.Play through the month to earn a badge, up to the top 1%.

                              CASUAL Five country puzzles a day.

                              1. Mystery Country

                              3. Deep Cut
                              4. Paint the Map
